title: The Last Ten Years Music Quiz
subtitle: Four rounds. Twenty seconds a question. Fastest fingers win.
notes: Written by hand for a Thursday-night gig on 20 August 2026, covering big, broadly-recognisable hits from 2016 through 2025 — nothing from 2026 itself, since that is too recent to check with any confidence. Read every question before the gig, same as any pack.

rounds.title: Round One — 2016 to 2018
rounds.blurb: 10 questions on the biggest hits of 2016, 2017 and 2018

questions.prompt: Which song, released in 2016, became a global hit after appearing in the animated film Trolls?
questions.answerNote: Written and performed by Justin Timberlake, it was nominated for an Oscar.

questions.prompt: Which Canadian rapper had a 2016 UK number one with 'One Dance'?
questions.answerNote: 'One Dance' spent 15 weeks at UK number one, a record at the time.

questions.prompt: Which act had a 2016 hit with 'Closer', featuring Halsey?
questions.answerNote: 'Closer' topped the US Billboard Hot 100 for twelve weeks.

questions.prompt: Which song gave Ed Sheeran a UK number one in January 2017, while his song 'Castle on the Hill' sat at number two?
questions.answerNote: Ed Sheeran occupied the top two chart positions simultaneously with these two singles.

questions.prompt: Which Spanish-language song by Luis Fonsi and Daddy Yankee became a global smash in 2017?
questions.answerNote: Despacito, with Justin Bieber on the remix, topped both the UK and US charts.

questions.prompt: Which rapper's 2018 hit 'God's Plan' broke streaming records worldwide?
questions.answerNote: The video showed Drake giving away nearly a million dollars to people in Miami.

questions.prompt: Which British singer-songwriter had a UK number one in 2018 with 'Shotgun'?
questions.answerNote: 'Shotgun' was the lead single from his album Staying at Tamara's.

questions.prompt: Which two artists teamed up for the UK number one 'One Kiss' in 2018?
questions.answerNote: 'One Kiss' was Calvin Harris's ninth UK number one.

questions.prompt: Which British singer had a huge hit in 2017 with 'Human'?
questions.answerNote: 'Human' reached number two on the UK singles chart.

questions.prompt: Childish Gambino's provocative 2018 single and video, tackling gun violence in America, was called what?
questions.answerNote: It won Grammy Awards for both Song and Record of the Year.

rounds.title: Round Two — 2019 to 2020
rounds.blurb: 10 questions on the biggest hits of 2019 and 2020

questions.prompt: Which country-rap crossover by Lil Nas X became the longest-running US number one single ever, in 2019?
questions.answerNote: It spent 19 weeks at number one on the Billboard Hot 100, with Billy Ray Cyrus on the remix.

questions.prompt: Which Scottish singer-songwriter had a UK number one in 2019 with 'Someone You Loved'?
questions.answerNote: It was one of the best-selling singles of the decade in the UK.

questions.prompt: Which singer's 2019 single 'Bad Guy' became her international breakthrough hit?
questions.answerNote: 'Bad Guy' knocked 'Old Town Road' off the US number one spot.

questions.prompt: Which grime artist topped the UK singles chart in 2019 with 'Vossi Bop'?
questions.answerNote: It was Stormzy's first UK number one as a lead artist.

questions.prompt: Which duo had a 2019 hit with 'Señorita'?
questions.answerNote: The pair went on to date after filming the song's music video.

questions.prompt: Which artist's 2020 album Future Nostalgia produced the hit 'Don't Start Now'?
questions.answerNote: The album was widely praised for lifting spirits during the early pandemic lockdowns.

questions.prompt: Which song by The Weeknd, from his 2020 album After Hours, became one of the biggest-selling singles ever?
questions.answerNote: It spent a record-breaking number of weeks on the US Billboard Hot 100.

questions.prompt: Which former boy band member had a 2020 hit with 'Watermelon Sugar'?
questions.answerNote: It was originally released in 2019 but became a chart hit through 2020.

questions.prompt: Which US rapper's 2020 hit 'The Box' became known for its distinctive squeaking sound?
questions.answerNote: The squeak was created by producer 30 Roc using his own voice.

questions.prompt: Which American singer had a 2020 hit with 'Say So'?
questions.answerNote: The song was boosted by a viral TikTok dance craze.

rounds.title: Round Three — 2021 to 2022
rounds.blurb: 10 questions on the biggest hits of 2021 and 2022

questions.prompt: Which singer-songwriter's 2021 debut single 'Drivers License' became a global sensation and UK number one?
questions.answerNote: The song was widely believed to be about her Disney co-star Joshua Bassett.

questions.prompt: Which English singer had a UK number one in 2021 with 'Bad Habits'?
questions.answerNote: The music video saw Sheeran transform into a vampire-like creature.

questions.prompt: Which rapper had a 2021 hit called 'Montero (Call Me By Your Name)'?
questions.answerNote: The video's pole dance down to Hell caused plenty of controversy.

questions.prompt: Which singer's 2021 comeback single 'Easy On Me' led her album 30?
questions.answerNote: It broke the record for the biggest opening week of streams for a song released that year.

questions.prompt: Which two artists teamed up for the 2021 hit 'Stay'?
questions.answerNote: It became one of the fastest songs to reach a billion streams on Spotify.

questions.prompt: Which artist had a huge global hit in 2022 with 'As It Was'?
questions.answerNote: 'As It Was' was the lead single from his album Harry's House.

questions.prompt: Which duo scored a UK number one in 2022 with 'Unholy'?
questions.answerNote: Kim Petras became the first openly transgender woman to win the Grammy the song was nominated for.

questions.prompt: Which American singer had a 2022 hit called 'About Damn Time'?
questions.answerNote: The song became a viral TikTok dance sensation.

questions.prompt: Which singer had a 2022 hit with 'Break My Soul'?
questions.answerNote: The track was the lead single from her album Renaissance.

questions.prompt: Which Nigerian artist's song 'Calm Down', later remixed with Selena Gomez, was a huge global hit through 2022 and 2023?
questions.answerNote: The remix became one of the most-streamed songs on Spotify that year.

rounds.title: Round Four — 2023 to 2025
rounds.blurb: 10 questions on the biggest hits of 2023, 2024 and 2025

questions.prompt: Which singer had a global number one in 2023 with 'Flowers'?
questions.answerNote: The lyric 'I can buy myself flowers' became a viral empowerment anthem.

questions.prompt: Which act had a 2023 UK number one with 'Boy's a Liar Pt. 2'?
questions.answerNote: It reunited the British singer with the American rapper after her viral original version.

questions.prompt: Which singer's song 'What Was I Made For?', written for the 2023 film Barbie, won her an Oscar?
questions.answerNote: She won Best Original Song at the 2024 Academy Awards, her second Oscar overall.

questions.prompt: Which American singer had a 2023 hit with 'Kill Bill'?
questions.answerNote: The song was inspired by the Quentin Tarantino film series of the same name.

questions.prompt: Which BTS member had a 2023 solo hit called 'Seven', featuring Latto?
questions.answerNote: It became one of the biggest solo hits by any BTS member.

questions.prompt: Which US singer had back-to-back 2024 hits with 'Espresso' and 'Please Please Please'?
questions.answerNote: 'Please Please Please' was co-written with her then-boyfriend, actor Barry Keoghan.

questions.prompt: Which US singer had a 2024 breakout hit with 'Good Luck, Babe!'?
questions.answerNote: She became one of pop's biggest breakout stars of that year.

questions.prompt: Which UK artist coined 'brat summer' with her 2024 album Brat?
questions.answerNote: The album's lurid green cover became a cultural phenomenon of its own.

questions.prompt: Which US singer had a 2024 hit called 'Beautiful Things'?
questions.answerNote: He became known for performing backflips during live performances of the song.

questions.prompt: Which rapper's song 'Not Like Us' dominated 2024, later soundtracking his headline slot at the 2025 Super Bowl halftime show?
questions.answerNote: The Grammy-winning diss track was aimed at fellow rapper Drake; Lamar headlined Super Bowl LIX in February 2025.
